Callout.Name: Horse Taken from a Field
Callout.Message: Horse missing from a field, gate left open.
Callout.Advisory: No suspects, trailer tracks in the gateway.

Script.Line: Her stall was empty this morning and the gate was open.
She is chipped and she is worth real money. That is why they took her.
There are trailer tracks by the gate. They were in and out in ten minutes.

Lines.Approach: They walked it out to a trailer. The owner is distraught.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
